name: Science Meets Fiction. Experiencing Literature in the Context of Science, Technology and Society
description: „As Gregor Samsa awoke one morning from uneasy dreams he found himself transformed in his bed into a gigantic insect.“ Franz Kafka’s opening sentence to „The Metamorphosis“ captures something essential about literature: its transformative power. Literature allows us to adopt unusal perspectives and to become someone or something else. In this participatory reading and writing workshop, we will explore this transformative power of literature through texts featuring unusual protagonists, perspectives, and worlds. We follow a nose through nineteenth-century St. Petersburg; marvel with a fox at the appearance of a strange creature called a shopping mall; or witness a woman’s transformation into a plant.Inspired by these stories, participants write their own texts from unexpected perspectives, which might include topics from their field of studies: How would quantum particles tell stories? What does the world of a molecule look like? What if the coronavirus were to tell its version of the pandemic? The workshop concludes with a small public reading.
